acceptanceCriteria: Both Playwright adapters enforce record/attempt/link counts and a traversal-depth bound before full decode, returning the named run-evidence-*-bound incomplete codes with zero records.
TestAFUV1RunEvidenceBoundsIncomplete gains Playwright byte-bound, JUnit record/attempt/link and go traversal cases; each new case fails on the pre-fix code.
The AFU-V1-037 Traceability row moves from partial to implemented.
body: Suspected defect observed 2026-10-16 by the V1-0249 audit lane (PR #981, base 08195a48). AFU-V1-037 says record, attempt and link bounds apply before decode and walk. Actual: parsePlaywrightRun (internal/appflows/runingest.go, json.Unmarshal ~line 305) and parsePlaywrightReceipt decode the whole byte-bounded document (<=5 MiB) and then count; the /3 receipt has no maxRunDepth traversal bound. JUnit and go test -json count during the token walk and conform. Expected: a pre-decode count/depth pass for both Playwright adapters.
title: Flows run-evidence: Playwright adapters decode the whole document before applying AFU-V1-037 record/attempt/link and depth bounds
